listing.name: Dancing Stage Fusion PAL / jmokikearns-png
listing.summary: Dancing Stage Fusion (PS1, PAL) on modern Windows PCs: the original game recompiled to native code and running inside a modified StepMania 3.95, with HD rendering, dance-pad support, timing tools and extra songs. Includes a builder for an enhanced PS1 disc. Bring your own disc: no game data included.
